Create a mutate expression structure

Source: R/ast.R
make_mutate_expr.Rd

The mutate expression record. ir is the parsed expression IR (see R/ir.R); input_cols/output_type are cached from ir_cols()/ ir_infer_type() so the optimizer passes (fuse_mutates/ try_fuse_mutate_pair/prune_dead_columns/push_down_projections) mostly need only those two fields plus output_col. lower_mutate() (via gpu_mutate_expr()) reads ir for execution, and some optimizer checks look at it too (a vector literal, a checked integer node, a rowwise aggregate flag) to keep a dot or stop a rewrite.

Usage

make_mutate_expr(output_col, ir, schema)

Arguments

output_col

Output column name

ir

An IR node (the parsed mutate expression)

schema

List with names/types, used to resolve output_type via ir_infer_type() (which delegates to infer_mutate_output_type() unchanged for arithmetic ops)

Value

An expression list structure: list(output_col, ir, input_cols, output_type, checked_int); checked_int is the cell of new_checked_int_cell(): read whether the expression holds a checked integer node with record_checked_int()
